paper_reading.inventory_note: The PDF contains Figures 1-11, Tables 1-9 and Algorithm 1. All 36 rendered pages and the extracted text were checked. The arXiv record uses the non-exclusive distribution license and the project-page repository has no declared license, so no original pixels are reused. Six evidence-dense visuals are redrawn; the remaining source visuals are represented in prose or intentionally omitted below.
